public_source.paper: arXiv:2608.24876v1 Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses

observed_contract.candidate_form: localized Skill Memory patch proposed by a meta-agent; downstream model remains frozen
observed_contract.production_gate_estimator: paired per-item mean candidate-minus-base differences; bootstrap over independent task/items, not within-item trials
observed_contract.production_acceptance: bootstrap lower CI > 0 and number of materially regressed items <= reg_cap; no comparable items rejects

dense_reward_controls.hierarchical_resampling: task clusters and paired trials within selected tasks
dense_reward_controls.fail_closed_small_n: driver comments/code state that below the supported cluster regime the dense estimator returns p=1 rather than certifying

nonstatistical_checks: fingerprint verification that the prescribed carrier fired
inventory/lint/integrity checks in the driver workflow
observed_contract.artifact_observability_claim: README states each evolution round writes the evidence shown to the session, its plan, gate arithmetic, and ledger entry; a round admitting nothing is a valid outcome

maintenance_divergence.standalone_cli_acceptance: diagnosed repair rises AND held-out net > 0 AND regressions <= reg_cap; CI significance is computed but advisory and a nonsignificant candidate can be accepted for the stack
maintenance_divergence.production_difference: driver.py imports held_out_paired_gate from gates.py, whose accept condition requires the bootstrap lower CI > 0
maintenance_divergence.risk: an auxiliary/standalone gate can be mistaken for production semantics if source-version contracts do not bind the exact executable path

evidence.paper_summary: 35 of 37 completed model-benchmark pairs improve; reported gains include +17.8 points for GPT-5.6 Sol on tau-bench and +16.6 for Qwen3.6-27B on SkillFlow; advantage grows with horizon to +32.2 on longest tasks
evidence.tta_boundary: README explicitly reports TTA versus fixed M0 at four attempts as 60.9% versus 58.6% (+2.3 points) and not significant at this sample size
